stories.title: RSM Classic R2 — Three-Way Tie at 9-Under Heading Into Weekend

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: RSM Classic after 36 holes: Neergaard-Petersen, Thorbjornsen, Penge share the lead at 9-under. Nine players within 2 shots. Wild final weekend ahead at Sea Island. #PGATour

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text: Rasmus Neergaard-Petersen has not made a bogey in 36 holes at Sea Island. He's tied for the lead at the RSM Classic heading into the weekend. Keep an eye on this one. #PGATour #RSMClassic

stories.title: CME Group Tour Championship R2 — Kim Surges to 3-Shot Lead With Hole-in-One

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text: A Lim Kim made a HOLE-IN-ONE on No. 16 (7-iron, 168 yards) in Round 2 of the CME Group Tour Championship. She leads at 15-under, 3 ahead of Thitikul. Season finale getting exciting. #LPGA

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text: CME Group Tour Championship R2 leaderboard: Kim -15 | Thitikul -12 | Korda T-11 at -9. A Lim Kim is making a serious move at the $11M LPGA season finale. #LPGA
